notes: Final controller (timed waypoint state machine with IK, grasp xy tracked from the measured can position, grasp at 6.5 cm, slow transfer/lower, gripper fully open before retreat) succeeded in 57/57 episodes over the practice setup, 30 random can/place layouts, 16 other random layouts and 6 hand-picked layouts; place error 0.5-1.5 cm, all upright, no drops. The 57-episode sample is small, so the true rate is probably high but not certain to be 100%.
